workloads.label: resnet-global
workloads.reason: manifest full workload; C4 global-pool path; priority workload (largest baseline latency, highest headroom). Round 1 winner = G1 flat-spatial-axis C4 path (CH_GLOBAL=32, 166.26->16.78us). Round 3 winner = G11 fp16 cheap reduce chain (reduce_sum f16->f16 + single vcast, dropping the fp32 full-plane intermediate) with plane-aware CH_GLOBAL=64 -> ab_test interleaved verdict B_better, merged median 15.98us vs 16.61us (-3.79%), direction consistent 3/3 pairs; final 16.13us. Ratio (compute-roofline, same formula as the Stage-5 report) 2.81% -> 47.99% (mechanism: removing the fp32 vector plane collapses the op-mix-weighted computility denominator; the substantive gain is latency). Precision: blocking L0/L1 max_diff <= 4.883e-04 (tolerance 1e-3; bf16 unaffected).

workloads.label: spp-6x6
workloads.reason: manifest full workload; general-grid path. Round 1/2: full CH sweep (16/32/64/128) gave no valid gain so baseline CH=64 kept (16.13us). Round 3 winner = G14 `_pick_ch_general` v2 (maximise single-wave core occupancy, then minimise the last block's wasted channels) -> CH=48, BlockDim 24->36, ab_test interleaved verdict B_better, merged median 15.46us vs 16.32us (-5.27%), direction consistent 3/3 pairs; final 15.53us.

workloads.label: nondiv-7x7
workloads.reason: manifest full workload; general-grid path with non-divisible bins. Round 1 winner = G2 single-wave CH dispatch (CH_GENERAL=32). Round 3: the G14 heuristic keeps CH=32 here because step 2 (least wasted channels) breaks the tie against CH=48 (which regressed +4.8% in branch r3_gen48); merged 13.24us / final 13.17us vs round-2 13.20us -> no regression (within the 3% noise threshold).
